title.narrative: Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation (CAREC) Corridor 2 (Mangystau Oblast Section) Investment Program - Tranche 2

description.narrative: The objective of the Investment Program is to increase transport connectivity and efficiency, and institutional effectiveness through the following activities: (a) road development (reconstruction of about 790 km of the road sections of the CAREC Corridor 2 in the Mangystau Oblast); (b) strengthening capacity for planning, project management and asset management; and (c) improving cross-border infrastructure and facilities. As part of the Investment Program, the Project aims to increase transport connectivity and efficiency in the Mangystau region. The Project will comprise the following components: (a) reconstruction of (i) an 86.7 km road section between the cities of Shetpe and Zhetybay and (ii) an 83 km road section between the cities of Zhetybay and Aktau; and (b) support for construction supervision.

c. By 2018: Reduced road-user costs to $0.43/vehicle-km from $0.64/vehicle-km in 2010 on Shetpe-Zhetybay-Aktau road sections. Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Final measurement to be provided in project completion report by the EA. Data Source: Annual report of the Ministry of Investment and Development

g. By 2021: Reduced travel time between Zhetybay and Zhanaozen to 1 hour from 1.5 hours in 2013 Achievement: 1 Progress/Status: Travel time reduced from 1.5 hours in 2013 to 1 hour in 2020. Data Source: Annual report of the Ministry of Interior of the Republic of Kazakhstan

f. By 2021: Increased traffic volume to 14,332 vpd from 11,780 vpd in 2013 on section between Zhetybay and Zhanaozen Achievement: 3817 Progress/Status: Road was open to public in Sept 2020 and the traffic counted was during winter month. Traffic count for the target year not yet reflected. Data Source: Annual report of the Ministry of Investment and Development

a. By 2018: Increased traffic volume to 1,700 vpd from 1,200 vpd in 2012 on section between Shetpe and Zhetybay Achievement: 2867 Progress/Status: Traffic volume increased from 1,200 vpd in 2012 to 2,867 vpd in 2020. Data Source: Annual report of the Ministry of Investment and Development

b. By 2018: Increased traffic volume to 5,600 vpd from 1,200 vpd in 2012 on section between Aktau and Zhetybay Achievement: 10808 Progress/Status: Traffic volume increased from 1,200 vpd in 2012 to 10,808 vpd in 2020. Data Source: Annual report of the Ministry of Investment and Development

e. By 2018: Reduced travel time between Aktau and Shetpe to 2 hours from 3.5 hours in 2012 Achievement: 2 Progress/Status: Travel time reduced from 3.5 hours in 2012 to 2 hours in 2020. Data Source: Annual report of the Ministry of Interior of the Republic of Kazakhstan

d. By 2018: Number of accidents per year on Shetoe-Zhetybay-Aktau sections reduced to 45 from 68 in 2009 Achievement: 9 Progress/Status: Road crash and fatality decreased in remarkable number of 9 accidents in 2019. Data Source: Annual report of the Ministry of Investment and Development
